# TFormNormal

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Transforms](Blitz3D-Transforms)

```blitzbasic
TFormNormal x#, y#, z#, source_entity%, dest_entity%
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Converts a surface normal from one space to another, and makes the result exactly 1 unit long again. Where TFormVector would stretch a direction with the scale of the entity, a normal keeps its length, which is what lighting and bouncing calculations need. The result is read back with [TFormedX](TFormedX), [TFormedY](TFormedY) and [TFormedZ](TFormedZ).

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()

ramp = CreateCube()
RotateEntity ramp, 0, 0, 30
ScaleEntity ramp, 4, 1, 1

; The top of the cube points up in its own space; in the world it is tilted.
TFormNormal 0, 1, 0, ramp, 0
Text 8, 8, "Top normal: " + TFormedX() + ", " + TFormedY() + ", " + TFormedZ()
Flip
WaitKey
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | Float | required | X of the normal in the source space. |
| `y` | Float | required | Y of the normal in the source space. |
| `z` | Float | required | Z of the normal in the source space. |
| `source_entity` | Int | required | Entity whose space the normal is in, or 0 for the world. |
| `dest_entity` | Int | required | Entity whose space the result should be in, or 0 for the world. |
